title: Grateful Dead Live at Hofheinz Pavilion - University of Houston on 1972-11-19

ai_review.summary: A good soundboard capture that leans bass‑heavy, showcasing a jazzy Bird Song and a soaring Dark Star among other standouts.
ai_review.review: The performance shines with an inventive, passionate Garcia and a standout Bird Song that many rank among the top ’72 versions. Phil’s solo out of Dark Star into a Weather Report‑style jam and a powerful Box of Rain add extra heat, though the mix is noticeably bass‑forward for some listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical show (high energy, standout songs) balanced against a slightly off, bass‑heavy soundboard mix; overall weighted rating lands in the good‑to‑great range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is slightly off and very bass‑forward—Lesh dominates the low end—but many listeners find it clearer than other copies of this show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows through deep improvisational passages, highlighted by jazzy interplay and a notable Phil solo that bridges Dark Star into a Weather‑Report‑like section.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's phrases are described as endlessly inventive and full of passion throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for taking a solo out of Dark Star that veers into Weather Report territory.
